_comment: Gemma-only smoke: 12 conditions x 4 cases = 48 runs, ~45min. Exists so the arm that has never completed a case can be proven end to end without paying for a 3h eight-arm smoke. Verify with smoke_check.py --expected-conditions 12.
_seed_rationale: shuffle=true because limit takes rows[:N] and the first five testset entries are all order-management.json. Seed 12116 is a coverage device, not a measurement: its first four shuffled entries span four distinct logs INCLUDING bpic2017-ocel2.json, the 2.2 GB log most likely to fail on time or memory, at the lowest gold-execution cost of any seed satisfying that (40k seeds searched). The project seed 3407 covers four logs but misses bpic2017 entirely.
